_why: ADR 0092's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
NOT MY RECORD -- a concurrent agent's. Written for them rather than
asked for, per the standing policy set when the fifth such ADR arrived:
asking costs a line in NOT-YET-REPRODUCIBLE.txt every pass and moves
nothing; writing the set costs one additive file and closes the entry.
It is also the last group in docs/commentary-residue-baseline.txt that
was still marked OPEN FINDING -- covalent modification, affinity tags
and immobilisation. Jeske's warning was about pH, temperature, cofactors
and buffers; this is the same class of fact about the PROTEIN rather
than the conditions, and ADR 0029's variant filter cannot see it because
a His-tag is not a sequence change.
Measured before the fix: human LDH resolves a Ki of 0.00059 from a row
whose commentary reads 'recombinant His-tagged enzyme', and nothing in

mutations._note: The inversion this project has found more often than any other. `unstated` is silence; `native` is a curator saying the enzyme was free and unmodified. Collapsing them lets 'we were not told' read as 'it was the plain enzyme' -- the same shape as ADR 0029's `unstated` not being `wild_type`, one category over.

Not in the original table; added because the module's own docstring argues for the positive form and an argument in prose is not a check. `status != "modified"` returns True for `unstated`, `absent`, `tagged` and `immobilised` alike -- and the whole point is that silence is not a clean bill of health.
